t: Beezo matztza eno yotze yede chobato
s: Beezo matztza eno yotze yede chobato ubo t"v seipim: en adam yotze yede chobato bepesach lo bepat shel subbin (perush qelippa hannosheret min hachitta bishat ketishatah), velo bepat shel mursan (perush qelippa daqqa hannisheret bannapa achar yetziat haqqemach mittokah), lepi sheenan qeruyim lechem leinyan challa (kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shak"[d]), vehattora omra: "shibat yamim tokal alayv matztzot lechem vego'", ulehallan hu omer: "vehaya baakolkem millechem haaretz vego'", umippi hashshemua lamedu: "lechem" "lechem" ligzera shava, sheen adam yotze yede chobato bepesach ella bepat haqqaruy "lechem" leinyan challa:

Abal muttar lalush et haqqemach im hassubbin vehammursan shebbo veyotze bo yede chobato, shehare issa zo chayyebet bechalla im yesh bah keshiur chiyyub challa, dehaynu issaron. Abal im hiprish et hassubbin o et hammursan min haqqemach vechazar veerebo betoko velash mimmennu issa, kevan sheissa zo enah chayyebet bechalla ella im ken yesh bah keshiur challa lebad min hassubbin o hammursan — eno yotze yede chobat matztza, ella im ken akal kezayit lebad min hassubbin o min hammursan, dehaynu sheen hassubbin o hammursan mitztorpin likzayit matztza kemo sheenan mitztorpin leissaron leinyan challa:

Mittok shehutzreku chakamim lomar sheen yotzein bepat subbin lepi sheenah qeruya "lechem", mikkan atta lamed shehasubbin yekolin labo lide chimmutz kesheyyabou bemayim, shehare en yotzein ella bepat sheyyakol labo lide chimmutz. Bammeh debarim amurim? Besubbin, shehu qelippa mehachitta atzmah, abal qelippa miqqash sheqqorin shpryya"r — eno ba lide chimmutz:

Yotze adam yede chobato bematztza haasuya missolet neqiyya, apillu hi yapa kematztzato shel shelomoh. Ap al pi shehakkatub qerao "lechem oni", hare kebar ribbeta hattora "matztzot" "matztzot" harbeh peamim, lerabbot apillu kematztzato shel shelomoh, im ken mah talmud lomar: "lechem oni"? Perat lematztza shennaaset ashira bide adam, kegon sheereb bah yayin o shemen o debash o shear kol hammashqin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b:

Veken im asaah gelusqa gedola kemo shishshit haepa, vehi niqret "ashisha", vehu derek chashibut ugedulla — hare zo matztza ashira veeno yotze bah. Lepikak, tob lizzaher shello laasot hammatztza shel mitzva rechaba yoter midday, shello tehe nireh keen ashisha:

Veken im chalat haqqemach berotechin qodem hallisha veachar kak lash oto veasa mimmennu issa shebbelilato aba vaapaah battannur kemo shear pat — eno yotze bah, dekevan shechalatah berotechin — hare zo matztza ashira (shekken derek haashirim lachlot haqqemach kede lelabbeno). Abal im leachar shennechlat haqqemach asa mimmennu issa shebbelilatah rakka vaapaah battannur — yotze bah, hoil ubelilatah rakka — en zo matztza ashira. Vekol zeh bematztza shel mitzva, abal shear hammatztzot ben shebbelilatan rakka uben shebbelilatan aba leachar shennechlat haqqemach berotechin — en bekak kelum, veen kan chashash chimmutz lomar: shemma kebar nitchammetz haqqemach keshehaya betok harotechin qodem shehitchil laasoq bah beyadayim belisha vaarika, lepi shertichat harotechin memaheret lebashshel et haqqemach qodem, vekevan shennitbashshel — shub enah baa lide chimmutz leolam ap leachar shennachu harotechin meretichatam, kemo sheddabar haapuy eno ba lide chimmutz leolam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"g:

Vekol zeh middina digmara, abal haggeonim aseru lanu kol min chalita berotechin, lepi sheen anu beqiin bachalitat harotechin, veyesh lachosh shemma lo yartiach et hammayim yapeh yapeh. Veim nopla chatikat issa shel matztza letok harotechin shebbaqqedera ap al pi shehotziah miyyad — hare kol mah shebbaqqedera asur baakila, abal muttar bahanaa, o lehashhot ad leachar happesach im yesh sham shishshim keneged haissa, sheen anu machamirin kol kak bachalita leesor bemashshehu apillu bahanaa, o lehashhoto, veday sheoserin baakila:

Issa sheosin bishbil hakkelabim shel haroim, im nitkavven baasiyyatah gam bishbil akilat adam, kegon shehaya bedato sheggam haroim yoklu mimmenna kesheyyirtzu — yotzein bah bepesach im nishmera mechimmutz, apillu hu pat qibbar. Abal im lo asaah ella bishbil hakkelabim bilbad, shello haya bedato sheyyoklu haroim mimmenna — en yotzein bah. Vaapillu naaset missolet neqiyya vahare hi reuya laakilat kol adam vehi chayyebet bechalla, mikkol maqom hare lo nishmera mechimmutz leshem matztzat mitzva, ella leshem hakkelabim. Veyesh omerim sheim enah reuya laakilat haroim, kegon sheereb bah mursan harbeh, apillu im haya bedato sheggam haroim yoklu mimmenna — betela dato etzel kol adam, veen yotzein bah apillu akal harbeh mimmenna beinyan sheakal kezayit lebad min hammursan shebbah, dekevan sheenah reuya laakilat haroim — enah qeruya lechem kelal upetura min hachalla. Veken iqqar:

En adam yotze yede chobato ella bematztza shello, shenneemar kan "lechem", veneemar lehallan bechalla: "vehaya baakolkem millechem haaretz vego'", mah lehallan en adam chayyab lehaprish challa ella keshemmegalgel issa shello abal lo shel chabero, ap kan eno yotze yede chobato ella beshello abal lo beshel chabero, ella im ken netano lo bemattana, sheaz naasa shello mammash. Abal im (akal matztza shel chabero shello middato, veen tzarik lomar im) gezalah mechabero vaakalah — lo yatza, shehare im ba hannigzal litboa oto mimmennu chayyab lehachazirah lo, veeno yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim beal korcho shel hannigzal — nimtzet sheenah shello:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheggazal matztza, abal im gazal qemach vaasaah matztza vaakalah — yatza, shehare im ba hannigzal litboa et hammatztza eno chayyab littenah lo, ella meshallem lo deme qimcho veniptar mimmennu. Veap al pi shehammatztza naaset miqqimcho, mikkol maqom kebar qana haggazlan et haggezela al yede shinnuy maaseh sheasa bah, dehaynu sheasa miqqemach pat, veal yede ken naaset keshello mammash, vedamim bilbad hu shechayyab lehannigzal, lepikak yotze bo yede chobato. Umikkol maqom (lekattechilla en lo latzet bo yede chobato, mittaam shennitbaer besiman y"a. Veim en lo matztza acheret — al kol panim) lo yebarek alayv, apillu gazal qemach o chittim minnokri, dekevan sheal yede abera baa leyado mitzva zo — en zeh mebarek ella menaetz (shennireh kimbarek al abera shennizdammena leyado). Bammeh debarim amurim? Baggazlan atzmo, abal im natan matztza zo laacherim — muttarim lebarek aleha, shehare lo al yede abera baa mitzva zo leyadam, (she)kevan shekkebar qenaah haggazlan beshinnuy qodem shennetanah lahem:

Abal im gazal matztza unetanah laacherim — enan yotzein bah, ella im ken nityaesh mimmenna hannigzal qodem shennetanah lahem haggazlan, sheaz niqnet hi lahem beyeush veshinnuy reshut (perush mereshut haggazlan lirshutam). Umuttarim hem az lebarek aleha, shehare lo al yede abera baa mitzva zo leyadam, shekkebar nityaesh hannigzal mimmenna qodem shebbaa leyadam. Veim leachar shennetanah haggazlan lahem bemattana gemura hecheziru otah lo venatenu lo bemattana gemura — muttar lo latzet bah yede chobato ulebarek aleha, sheakshayv en hammitzva baa leyado baabera:

Mi shehotzi matztza mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid belel t"v shechal lihyot beshabbat — muttar lo latzet bah yede chobato ulebarek aleha, veen zo mitzva habbaa baabera, kevan shehayeta shello qodem shehotziah o hiknisah — nimtza shello baa mitzva zo leyado al yede abera, ella shehu oseh bah abera, abal hi lo naaset baabera, velo baa leyado al yede abera sheasa hu:

Kesheharbeh bene adam opin matztzot shel mitzva betannur echad — tob sheyyomar kol echad mehem: "kol mi shehiggia matztzati leyado hare hi netuna lo bemattana", lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yitchallepu matztzot shel zeh lazeh, veen adam yotze ella bematztza shello. Veken tob lomar bishat hattechina keshettochanin harbeh beyachad, shellipamim mitchallep haqqemach venimtza mebarek shello kaddat:

Im shaal matztza mechabero — yotze bah yede chobato lekattechilla, shehare lo hishilah lo al menat sheyyachazirenna lo, ella al menat sheyyoklenna veyachazir lo matztza acheret, venimtza matztza zo hi shello mammash lekol dabar (ayyen siman ts"a):

Keshem sheen adam yotze bematztza sheeno shello, kak en adam yotze bemaror sheeno shello, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim vego'", huqqeshu zeh lazeh lekol hilkotehem. Vegam akshayv bizman hazzeh shemmitzvat akilat maror enah ella middibre soperim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"h, mikkol maqom kol mah shettiqqenu chakamim — tiqqenu keen shel tora:
